EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 4
EPISODE LOGLINE: Nadia tears up the confession, an anonymous bail payment frees her, and Theo admits who he really is.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 3 cliffhanger: Selene demands Nadia sign a confession before sunrise.
